MundoQuantico.projectDesc: Mundo Quântico is a web page featuring illustrated stories and educational projects designed for classroom use, offering an interactive and accessible approach to teaching physics and quantum computing concepts.
MundoQuantico.projectDesc1: This project was developed to introduce physics and quantum computing projects to elementary school students. The idea came from the book 'Physics and Quantum Computing Projects for Elementary Education', created by the UESB-QuIIN team. The platform features illustrated stories and educational projects designed for classroom use, offering an interactive and accessible approach to teaching physics and quantum computing concepts.
MundoQuantico.projectDesc2: The project was developed with Node.js using the Next.js framework. The application has a main page with navigation links to other sections of the site. A dynamic routing system was implemented using the App Router, with the experimento/[name] folder pattern to generate pages based on URL parameters. The site's data is centralized in a JavaScript constant, serving as a content source for reusable pages.
MundoQuantico.projectDesc3: The project includes features such as responsive design, dynamic routes, and lazy loading, providing users with a smooth browsing experience. Every part was built with speed and efficiency in mind.
MundoQuantico.projectDesc4: This project helped me improve my Next.js skills and reinforced the importance of componentization. The final result meets the project's goals and can be expanded in the future.

DrCarlos.projectDesc: This landing page was developed to present legal services. Its structure focuses on converting visitors into potential clients, highlighting key services, and making it easy for users to get in touch.
DrCarlos.projectDesc1: This project was developed as a landing page for lawyers, with the goal of presenting legal services in a clear, professional, and accessible way. It aims to build trust with users and make that first contact easier.
DrCarlos.projectDesc2: The site was built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, focusing on performance, organization, and responsiveness. The page structure was designed to guide users intuitively through the information.
DrCarlos.projectDesc3: The page includes features such as responsive design, well-organized sections, and calls to action (CTAs), making it easy for users to navigate and get in touch quickly.
DrCarlos.projectDesc4: This project helped me improve my front-end development and landing page design skills, while reinforcing the importance of conversion-focused design.
